changelog: Major v1.4.0 overhaul: minimalist emoji-free 3-tab UI (Tools, Plugins, Logs), unified Profile combobox, Settings & Diagnostics dialogs, custom ToggleSwitch & status badges, modular architecture, critical safety & thread-safety fixes (managed-only process control, serialized atomic MCP config sync, QLocalServer single-instance, LOCALAPPDATA storage), and 100% English + Turkish localization.
